## F. Formal offer of evidence

When you offer our exhibits, the stated purposes will frame the case for the court. I would be grateful to see them. In particular, for Exhibit "E" (the 1992 SPA): offered to prove that Cesar's authority was confined to third persons holding Llamanzares contracts to sell, after prior consultation with the co-owners, and that the defendant was outside that class; for Exhibit "B": that T-52540 stood in the co-owners' names, that no revocation was ever annotated, and that the entire registration of the 2016 sale occurred only in November 2021.
